concept.title: People going through menopause
concept.shortdesc: People experiencing menopause or perimenopause and their partners, along with related women's health issues such as pelvic floor weakness.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
